rules: Keys are stable identifiers and are never displayed to players.
Do not construct keys by concatenating translated text.
IDs, GUIDs, build identifiers, paths, version numbers and brand names marked as protected are not translated.
Money, dates, time, percentages and quantities are locale-formatted; symbols are not concatenated manually.
Plural-sensitive entries must use Smart Strings or an equivalent locale-aware formatter.

limitations: This is the reviewed Phase 5 baseline catalog, not proof that every string has already been migrated.
Implementation must run an automated hardcoded-string audit to catch newly added or indirect strings.
Log-only diagnostics and exception messages that cannot reach player UI are excluded unless later surfaced.
Technical content catalog keys marked PROPOSED_DEFERRED_UNLESS_VISIBLE enter runtime tables only if their data becomes visible in the Golden Path.
